description: Hourly clear-sky UV index for one day at any point, with the day's peak UV, the time of the peak and the WHO exposure band (low, moderate, high, very high, extreme) with plain protection advice. For sun-safety, outdoor work and holiday planning. Source: MET Norway Locationforecast 2.0. Values assume a cloudless sky, so real UV is lower under cloud (cloud cover is included); UV is only given for the first few days of the forecast. Needs lat and lon: for a UK place name or postcode, get coordinates from geocode or postcode_lookup first. (cost: 1 credit)

date.description: string, optional, day as YYYY-MM-DD within the next ~3 days, default today (at utc_offset)

lat.description: number, required, latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

lon.description: number, required, longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

utc_offset.description: string, optional, local UTC offset (-12:00 to +15:00) used to define the day, e.g. +01:00 for UK summer time, default +00:00

name: uv_index_forecast
